notes: New: Zoom in and out of your snap with the new + and − buttons in the toolbar.
New: Press Shift + Z to zoom in, or Alt + Shift + Z to zoom out.
New: Press Ctrl + plus or Ctrl + minus to zoom in and out.
New: Scroll the mouse wheel over your snap to zoom in and out.
Improved: Each snap opens at its normal size, even if you zoomed in on the last one.
